headline.plain_language: Enrolling 340 patients at 85 sites is simulated to take 398 months — at or beyond the 48-month bar, so the trial is infeasible as designed and no biomarker relaxation rescues it.
headline.title: Trial recruitability — IRAK4 inhibitor (small molecule) in rheumatoid arthritis

limitations.message: Every number in this result is SIMULATED — a model output, never an observed enrolment. The field names say so on purpose; keep the label in any UI.

Enrollment duration is not automatically equivalent to launch delay. Consumers pricing programs must derive delay (months beyond their own plan) from their baseline; these months are a recruitment forecast, not a program schedule.

score is a heuristic operational-recruitability index (linear between the 18- and 48-month thresholds). It is NOT a probability, and mapping it — or waterfall_delta — to probability of approval is a category error.

The eligibility multiplier is a language-model judgement over real precedent I/E prose (median of 3 reads) — treat it as ASSUMED-grade, not measured. The cited NCT ids are checkable on clinicaltrials.gov.
The linear competition penalty is uncalibrated for extremely crowded indications (~189 concurrent trials here): treat the month count as a design-failure signal, not a schedule.

lineage.transformation: required_n / (sites × base_velocity × max(prevalence × eligibility_multiplier, 0.1) × 1/(1 + 0.08 × competing_trials)), rounded up — every factor derived from registry searches on the disease name (horizon-filtered when as_of_date is set)
effect size d=0.35 (see step.sample_size and step.powering)
language-model read of precedent inclusion/exclusion prose (median of 3 samples)
page-scaled registry count of interventional trials actively recruiting the condition
linear ramp on simulated_months_to_enroll: 1 at ≤18 months to 0 at ≥48
threshold bucketing of simulated_months_to_enroll (≤18 FEASIBLE; <48 FEASIBLE_WITH_RISK; ≥48 INFEASIBLE_TRIAL_DESIGN)

metrics.label: Simulated months to enroll
metrics.meaning: Modeled months to enroll 340 patients at 85 sites. SIMULATED — a model output, never an observed enrolment; and enrollment duration is not automatically equivalent to launch delay.

metrics.label: Recruitability score (heuristic)
metrics.meaning: Heuristic operational-recruitability index: 1 at ≤18 simulated months, 0 at ≥48, linear between. It is not a probability of any event — reading it as probability of approval is a category error.

metrics.label: Required N
metrics.meaning: Patients to enroll. Derivation: effect size d=0.35.

metrics.label: Sites
metrics.meaning: Site count used by the simulation (basis: precedent).

metrics.label: Screening burden
metrics.meaning: Disease patients screened per enrolled patient, 1/(prevalence × eligibility). The active-screening floor keeps months finite at low prevalence; this is where that cost actually lands.

metrics.label: Precedent enrollment velocity
metrics.meaning: Median observed enrolment velocity across 196 completed precedent trials, with each registry window corrected for the trial's own endpoint follow-up.

metrics.label: Competing recruiting trials
metrics.meaning: Interventional trials actively consenting the same population; each takes an equal share of enrolment velocity in the model.

metrics.label: Precedent median N
metrics.meaning: Median enrolment of comparable completed trials — the reality check printed beside required_n. Null when no precedent carries counts.

metrics.label: Phase-3 precedent median N
metrics.meaning: Median N of phase-3 precedents — the registrational-reality anchor that can floor required_n. Null when none exist.

metrics.label: Waterfall contribution
metrics.meaning: Signed contribution to the thesis's evidence waterfall, derived from the heuristic score. Not a probability and not an approval-odds adjustment.

steps.label: Gather completed precedent trials
steps.method: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 search: completed interventional trials in the condition, horizon-filtered when as_of_date is set

steps.formula: median(enrollment / sites / enrolling_months) over usable precedents
steps.label: Observed enrollment velocity
steps.method: median patients/site/enrolling-month across usable precedents, each registry window corrected for its own endpoint follow-up

steps.label: Eligibility pass rate
steps.method: median of 3 claude-sonnet-5 reads of real precedent inclusion/exclusion prose — the one judgement step; drivers and reasoning are preserved verbatim in output.eligibility

steps.label: Biomarker + eligibility narrowing
steps.method: floored product: below the floor, sites pre-screen for the marker rather than wait on clinic flow

steps.label: Screening burden
steps.method: unfloored inverse of the narrowing product — where the low-prevalence cost lands when the velocity floor applies

steps.label: Competition penalty
steps.method: each concurrently recruiting interventional trial takes an equal share of the patient pool

steps.label: Base sample size
steps.method: textbook two-arm powering from the predicted effect size (80% power, alpha 0.05 two-sided), inflated for dropout

steps.label: Required N (registrational floor)
steps.method: phase-3 precedent floor checked and not binding; the base estimate stands

steps.label: Site count
steps.method: 75th percentile of site counts among precedents that enrolled ≥ required_n/2 (a sponsor sizes like the upper quartile of at-scale trials), clamped to the programme range

steps.label: Effective per-site velocity
steps.method: product of the velocity, narrowing, and competition terms

steps.label: Recruitability score (heuristic)
steps.method: linear ramp between the comfort and infeasibility thresholds

steps.formula: months ≤ 18 → FEASIBLE; 18 < months < 48 → FEASIBLE_WITH_RISK; months ≥ 48 → INFEASIBLE_TRIAL_DESIGN
steps.label: Feasibility verdict
steps.method: threshold bucketing of the simulated months (the same thresholds that define the score); registry-stated trial failures in the indication are attached as context evidence

steps.label: Counterfactual rescue search
steps.method: bisection over the months-vs-prevalence curve for the smallest biomarker relaxation reaching the good/feasible thresholds — the only lever the thesis itself controls

steps.label: Waterfall contribution
steps.method: linear recentering of the heuristic score

limitations: The bounds vary ONLY the precedent velocity (fast = its 75th percentile, slow = its 25th). They are velocity scenarios — not percentiles of a predictive months distribution and not a confidence interval.
Eligibility-multiplier sampling variance, site-count choice, and competition-count error are not propagated into the range.
The eligibility multiplier is the median of 3 unseeded language-model reads; repeat runs can differ slightly.
uncertainty.method: Scenario range over observed precedent-velocity percentiles: the low bound is months at the 75th-percentile (fast) velocity, the high bound at the 25th (slow). Scenario bounds, not a confidence interval.

why: 340 patients (effect size d=0.35) at 85 sites (p75 of at-scale precedents); precedent velocity 0.65 pt/site/mo across 196 completed trials (sampled from 2268 registered), narrowed by 62% biomarker prevalence and 40% eligibility pass rate, with ~189 interventional trials competing for the same patients.
